evidence: Built coverage_assert.py, which audits the manifests emit_result.py actually produced by enumerating the files each artifact commit really holds, re-reading every one with git cat-file, and refusing on any absent, malformed or wrong hash or byte count, any uncovered file, any locator pointing outside the slot or at another commit, any count or total disagreement, and any result document that disagrees with its manifest or cites a manifest_sha256 that does not reproduce the committed manifest bytes. Measured result over the four slots completed before this unit: PO03_COVERAGE_PASS slots=4 artifacts=22 measured_bytes=164079 excluded_by_declaration=manifest.json,result.json, exit 0, captured verbatim in evidence/audit-live.txt; all 22 artifacts matched their recorded hash and byte count exactly. Ran python3 -I -m unittest discover over the unit subtree: 35 tests, OK, exit 0, captured in evidence/test-run.txt, covering 23 distinct refusal classes including a null hash, an empty hash, four malformed hash shapes, an absent hash field, six non-positive or non-integer byte counts, a wrong hash and a wrong byte count caught by measurement, and an omitted entry whose artifact_count and total_bytes were adjusted to stay internally consistent, which is still reported as UNCOVERED_FILE because the commit and not the manifest is the authority.
falsifiable_hypothesis: Hash and byte-count coverage over counted artifacts is total, so a partially hashed result cannot be counted.
limitations: emit_result.py excludes manifest.json and result.json by basename at any depth, so a payload file committed at <slot>/nested/manifest.json is durably in the commit and never counted, and nothing in the emitter reports it. This auditor excludes those two names only at the root of a slot and therefore reports UNCOVERED_FILE for such a file; unit 032 demonstrates the gap against the live emitter.
Coverage is judged against the artifact commit, so a file that was never staged is invisible to this auditor as well; catching that requires a working-tree source as in unit 025.
A slot holding artifacts but no manifest.json is reported MANIFEST_MISSING rather than skipped, which is correct for a gate but means a whole-repository audit exits 1 while any producer is mid-unit.

Building a scratch repository costs roughly twelve seconds on this runner. An earlier draft of the test suite built one repository per case and exceeded four minutes without finishing; it was restructured to share one repository per class and mutate candidate manifests in memory, which is why audit_documents accepts parsed documents.
